component.name: Bytescape
component.summary: See where the space on a drive is used

description.p: Bytescape scans a drive or folder and draws every file and folder as a box whose area is its size, so the biggest things stand out at once. Click into a folder to zoom in, step back out, and move a file to the Trash from the map.
It is a visualizer: it shows what is there and who manages it, and leaves the decisions to you. It never connects to the internet. Inspired by SpaceMonger 1.4.
